parallel.requirements: Recognized the clean-room task, no-source and no-wrapper constraints, documentation, executable observation, and need for a replacement executable matching walk behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used only the parent actor despite parallel mode. The plan focused on observation harnesses and empirical TUI probing, with no delegated child ownership.
parallel.implementation: Created /workspace/tools/drive.py, /workspace/tools/vt.py, and /workspace/tools/obs.sh as observation utilities; no replacement source or build script for walk was created.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact contained repository docs, the original executable, icons, git metadata, and the helper tools, but no integrated reimplementation deliverable.
parallel.verification: Verified reference behavior through PTY runs, help output, layout sweeps, and preview observations, but did not verify any produced implementation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out with empty final response and official compile_failed because there was no buildable clean-room implementation in the submission.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room reverse-engineering task and prohibited source/wrapper shortcuts from the identical prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked as one serial actor with workflows and delegation disabled, investing in systematic local observation before implementation.
serial.implementation: Created helper scripts under /tmp/h and test fixtures under /tmp, but did not create replacement program source files or a compile script in /workspace.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The submitted tree remained essentially the original workspace files without the temporary helpers, and no integrated reimplementation was delivered.
serial.verification: Collected more behavior observations than parallel, including version, invalid flags, movement, search, preview, border, and editor invocation, but verified only the reference binary.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Timed out with empty final response and official compile_failed because no buildable reimplementation was available for evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel read the clean-room prompt and docs, checked help output, and understood that behavior must be inferred from the executable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial read the same prompt and docs, checked help/version/bad flags, and also treated the task as clean-room behavioral reimplementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the outcome; serial covered a few more CLI surface cases, but both understood the main obligation and both failed to implement it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Despite the parallel-capable mode, status and protocol validation report no workflow calls, task calls, or subagents; the parent actor owned all work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial was configured with workflows disabled and the control-tool denylist, and the status record confirms no delegation or subagent activity.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The attempts did not differ by actual multi-agent decomposition. Both relied on one actor, though the parallel configuration allowed delegation and the serial configuration denied it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had no child briefs, handoffs, or cross-agent interfaces; all observed context stayed within one actor and its helper scripts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise had no child briefs or handoffs and maintained one local stream of observations and temporary helper outputs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no coordination-context failure. Any missing implementation context was ordinary incomplete task progress, not lost or conflicting cross-agent information.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented observation infrastructure in /workspace/tools and ran empirical layout sweeps, but stopped before coding the walk replacement.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented only temporary observation harnesses and fixtures in /tmp, gathered broader behavior data, and also stopped before coding the walk replacement.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial progressed further in behavioral characterization, especially search and preview modes; parallel put helper files in the final workspace. Neither produced the required program.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: There were no child results to retrieve or join; the run ended during observation with an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There were no child results by design; the serial run also ended at timeout with an empty final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No cross-agent result lifecycle difference exists. The relevant lifecycle failure in both modes is ordinary non-delivery of an implementation before timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote helper tools into the shared /workspace tree; artifact listing later included those tools plus the original workspace files but no replacement source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept its harness under /tmp and the artifact listing did not include those helpers; it still lacked any replacement source or build product.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel polluted the final tree with helper scripts, while serial did not. This did not create a concurrency write pattern because no concurrent actors or ownership collisions existed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified the reference binary behavior but performed no build or evaluator-aligned verification of an implemented replacement.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified reference behavior more extensively but likewise had no implementation to compile or test against evaluator expectations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed acceptance in the same way: official evaluation completed, reported compile_failed, and ran none of the 786 tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel exhausted the 2399 second process budget and returned 143 while still probing layout behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also exhausted the 2399 second process budget and returned 143 after more observation probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed by timeout rather than planned completion. Parallel consumed fewer requests and tokens; serial used more single-agent budget but neither reached implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed cell/status.json evaluations are not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with compile_failed and 0 of 786 tests passed. The parallel run stopped earlier in the workflow, after creating observation tools in /workspace and probing layout behavior, while the serial run gathered broader behavioral data in /tmp. Neither created a buildable clean-room reimplementation, so the official outcome difference is none.
